visual_action: A young woman identified as Hadley speaks directly to the camera and from a couch in a living room. Her testimony is intercut with childhood photos of her, text on a black screen, and a brief, serious-looking clip of Donald Trump. The video concludes with a clip of Kamala Harris speaking at a podium.

cast.name: Hadley
cast.evidence: A chyron identifies her as 'HADLEY / Midway, KY'. She is the narrator for most of the video.

cast.name: Kamala Harris
cast.evidence: Her face is shown at the end of the ad, she is mentioned by name in the top overlay text ('Kamala Harris' new ad...'), and she speaks the line 'I'm Kamala Harris, and I approve this message'.

cast.name: Donald Trump
cast.evidence: His face is shown in a close-up shot, and he is blamed for overturning Roe v. Wade in on-screen text ('Donald Trump killed Roe v. Wade.') and in the narration ('And Trump did this').

cast.name: Hadley's stepfather
cast.evidence: Hadley states she was 'sexually abused by my stepfather'.

on_screen_text.text: Kamala Harris' new ad hits hard 💙
Donald Trump killed Roe v. Wade.
Girls and women all over the country lost the right to choose.
APPROVED BY KAMALA HARRIS. PAID FOR BY HARRIS FOR PRESIDENT.

spoken_summary: A woman named Hadley recounts being sexually abused by her stepfather from age five and becoming pregnant by him at age twelve. She then states that 64,000 pregnancies from rape have occurred in states with total abortion bans, attributing this situation to Donald Trump. She asserts that women and girls need choices, and that 'With Kamala Harris, we do.' The ad concludes with Kamala Harris saying, 'I'm Kamala Harris, and I approve this message.'
audio_music: A slow, somber piano score plays throughout the video, creating a serious and emotional tone.
editing_pacing: The video has a slow and deliberate pace, using a mix of talking-head interviews, still photographs, and text on a black screen to build an emotional narrative.
central_claim: Donald Trump is responsible for ending abortion access for victims of rape and incest by overturning Roe v. Wade, while Kamala Harris will protect their right to choose.
intended_effect: To evoke outrage and sympathy to persuade viewers that Donald Trump's policies are dangerous for women and that they should support Kamala Harris to protect reproductive rights.
